headline: Votes on three policies: law enforcement relations, child abuse and neglect reporting, and public records access.
summary: Policy KLGC is new. Policies JLF and KDB are updates to existing policies. The meeting also includes an update on community input about screen time in classrooms.
items: Policy KLGC, Relations with Law Enforcement Personnel (new policy)
Policy JLF, Reporting Child Abuse and Neglect (update)
Policy KDB, Public's Right to Know/Freedom of Access (update)
Community input on screen time in classrooms
